Place & perspective

A home perspective, open to the world.

Charlot Crea is based in Antalya. The Türkiye collection now connects Fairmont Istanbul, Rixos Downtown Antalya, Balmy Beach Resort Kemer, Rixos Premium Tekirova and Güral Hotels. Photography and films bring different places and experiences into a portfolio that can be explored by city.

01

Hotel photography in Istanbul

Fairmont Istanbul is the featured project in this selected collection. Its gallery offers a concrete reference when discussing hotel photography in Istanbul. A new brief can identify the rooms, shared spaces and details that matter to the property, together with the audience and channels the photographs need to serve.

02

Architecture, interiors and the sense of place

Architectural photography in Türkiye can bring together a building’s overall presence and the smaller details that give a space its identity. Consider how daylight, materials, room relationships and the surrounding setting should be represented. A focused selection gives each image a purpose within the wider collection.

03

Planning from Antalya

For a photography enquiry in Antalya or elsewhere in Türkiye, share the location, preferred dates and intended deliverables. The project discussion can then cover preparation, access and the most useful mix of views and details. If film is also part of the brief, include its message and delivery channels so the requirements can be considered together.

Planning the shoot

Where is Charlot Crea based?

Charlot Crea is based in Antalya and works internationally. The Türkiye portfolio connects Istanbul, Antalya, Kemer and Tekirova photography with films for Balmy, Swandor and Güral Hotels.

Can I enquire about photography and film together?

Yes. Include both in your brief, with the location, audience and intended channels, so their production requirements can be discussed together.
